name: patchlens-ai
description: Local visual context layer for AI coding agents.

scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm typecheck:workspaces && corepack pnpm test:workspaces
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @patchlens-ai/dev... build && node packages/dev/dist/bin.js dev --cwd .
scripts.release:dry-run: corepack pnpm release:check && corepack pnpm build:packages && node scripts/dry-run-release.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/check-playwright-browser.mjs && corepack pnpm build:packages && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm typecheck:workspaces
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: corepack pnpm -r typecheck && corepack pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm test:workspaces
